name: type: epic
description: A product capability made of several issues. No code of its own.

name: type: feature
description: New behaviour a visitor or a host developer can see.

name: type: bug
description: Behaviour that breaks the README or a decision.

name: type: docs
description: Docs only: README, docs/, CLAUDE.md.

name: type: chore
description: Tooling, tests, CI or refactoring with no change in behaviour.

name: type: question
description: An investigation that answers a Q-xx in docs/decisions.md.

name: priority: p0
description: A security, privacy or cost rule is broken (D-01, D-04, D-09, D-17). Drop other work.

name: priority: p1
description: Blocks the current milestone.

name: priority: p2
description: Planned for the current or next milestone.

name: priority: p3
description: Worth doing; not scheduled.

name: difficulty: starter
description: One area, a few files, all named by the routing table.

name: difficulty: intermediate
description: Crosses one boundary: both ends of the protocol, or core and shell.

name: difficulty: advanced
description: Several areas, or an open question nearby. Read the decisions first.

name: status: blocked
description: Waits on another issue, named under Blocked by.

name: status: needs-decision
description: Waits on a Q-xx in docs/decisions.md. Don't pick an answer in code.

name: area: server
description: server/: route, bridge, tools, config.

name: area: kit
description: web/src/otto/: guidance, awareness, context, the panel.

name: area: voice
description: Live audio, playback, barge-in, wake word, sound.

name: area: robot
description: The robot, faces, gestures, movement.

name: area: packaging
description: <otto-mascot>, the adapters, the library build.
